caption: The drawing depicts a pair of moccasins positioned side by side on a plain, beige background. The moccasins are rendered primarily in shades of gray and black, with subtle hints of blue, especially around the lacing and seams. The left moccasin appears slightly more open at the top, showing some interior detail, while the right moccasin displays darker shadowing and more visible creases. Both moccasins have rounded toes and visible stitching lines. In the upper right corner, there is handwritten text in black ink providing descriptive information, including a name ("Margaret Knapp"), a date ("Oct. 20, 1938"), location ("Eastern Woodland"), and additional notes about the object ("CASE No. 81," "Malecite," "Fur = Moose"). The drawing is composed with the moccasins centered on the paper and the text confined to the top right, leaving ample empty space around the objects.
title: Booties
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
